info.name: Management
info.description:
Static legal and informational pages — About Us, Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy.

These back the tabs on the Settings screen. There is exactly one row per `type`, so writing is an upsert: posting `about` twice replaces the text rather than creating a second row.

**Allowed types:** `about`, `terms`, `privacy`

request.description:
Writes the content for one page type. **Super Admin only.**

**Auth:** session token of a `superAdmin`.

**Body**
| Field | Type | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| type | string | one of `about`, `terms`, `privacy` |
| description | string | the page body; HTML is accepted |

**Errors**
| Status | message |
|---|---|
| 400 | Type must be one of: about, terms, privacy |
| 403 | You are not authorized. |

Running this again with the same `type` overwrites the existing text — there is a unique constraint on `type`, so duplicates cannot happen.

Fetches one page. **Auth:** none — this is public, so the Privacy Policy and Terms can be shown before sign-in. **Returns** ```json { "data": { "id": 3, "type": "privacy", "description": "

Privacy Policy

...", "createdAt": "2026-02-18T05:12:33.000Z", "updatedAt": "2026-10-19T09:40:00.000Z" } } ``` If nothing has been written for that type yet, `data` is `null` — render an empty state rather than an error.

Every page type in one paged list. **Super Admin only.**

**Auth:** session token of a `superAdmin`.

Same pagination shape as `GET /users/all-user` — `pagination` sits beside `data`.
